name: Alabaster
overview: Scripture presents alabaster as a white stone used to make precious vessels, specifically boxes containing costly ointments. In the Gospels of Matthew, Mark, and Luke, women bring alabaster boxes of fragrant ointment to Jesus, demonstrating acts of devotion and worship by anointing Him with these valuable substances. These passages highlight the symbolic significance of the alabaster vessel as a container of something precious, underscoring the reverence and honor given to Christ.
